Due to a longstanding territorial dispute, no direct flight corridor exists between Outpost Alpha and Outpost Beta.  
Furthermore, operational protocols mandate that exactly one of the following two flight segments must be incorporated into the itinerary: the route between Outpost Beta and Outpost Gamma, or the route between Outpost Gamma and Outpost Delta.

The objective is to determine the most fuel-efficient closed-loop flight path that visits each outpost precisely once before returning to the point of origin.
